conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.location="australia-southeast1" AND resource.labels.service_name=("createvariation" OR "updatevariationdraft" OR "approvevariation" OR "applyvariationcommitment" OR "progressclaimoperation" OR "supplierinvoiceoperation" OR "suppliersettlementoperation" OR "postclientrefund" OR "voidclientrefund" OR "postclientreceiptapplication" OR "voidclientreceiptapplication" OR "voidclientinvoice" OR "contractvalueoperation" OR "estimateoperation" OR "postclientcreditnote" OR "voidclientcreditnote" OR "postclientretentionrelease" OR "voidclientretentionrelease" OR "postclientreceipt" OR "voidclientreceipt" OR "transferboqtobudget" OR "approvefinalaccount") AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/stdout") AND jsonPayload.message=("variation call refused" OR "supplier-finance call refused" OR "client finance call refused" OR "contract-value call refused" OR "estimate call refused" OR "boq transfer call refused" OR "final account call refused") AND jsonPayload.code=("client-receipt-baseline-inconsistent" OR "client-receipt-baseline-invalid" OR "client-receipt-baseline-missing" OR "client-receipt-baseline-too-large" OR "supplier-finance-baseline-invalid")

documentation.subject: A project's historical baseline was refused
documentation.content:
## What this means

An operation was refused because a project's historical baseline cannot be established or is not usable. **Every operation of that family stays refused in that project until it is reviewed**; nothing was written, no figure was clamped and no history was rewritten.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `supplier-finance-baseline-invalid` | The first supplier-finance operation found a posted payment, credit note or release that cannot be attributed to an invoice, or a claim naming no purchase order (MISSING SOURCE, ADR-94); or an operation found the marker absent or not `complete`. |
| `client-receipt-baseline-invalid` | A legacy posted receipt has a malformed allocation (ADR-89). |
| `client-receipt-baseline-inconsistent` | A posted receipt already carries backend fields while no marker exists, or a ledger already carries receipts. |
| `client-receipt-baseline-too-large` | Legacy receipts touch more than 448 invoices; an operator baseline is needed. |
| `client-receipt-baseline-missing` | The marker is absent at an operation that requires it. |

## Do this

1. Find the line: `jsonPayload.message:"call refused" AND jsonPayload.code=~"baseline"` in the services above. Note the time, `fn`, `uid`. The project id is not on the refusal line: take it from the user, or from the matching request in the same minute.
2. Run the read-only inventory for that company: `node ops/recovery/phase2-inventory.mjs --project constrapp-69b5d --company <companyId>` and read `supplierBaselinePreview` and `baselineSource` for the project. It names every unattributable document by id and code.
3. Tell the Product Owner which project is blocked. A repair needs a reviewed, separately authorised plan; there is no repair tool and none may be improvised. Never edit a register, a ledger or a marker in the console.

Repeats are expected: every attempt in that project is refused again. This notification is sent at most once an hour.

Never paste a log entry, an amount, a customer name or a token into a ticket or chat: give the service, the time, the project and document ids, and the code.

Runbook: `ops/monitoring/phase2/README.md`. Cutover and recovery: `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`, section *Phase 2 — the complete cutover*.
